title: About Me
bio1: I am a pediatric neurologist trained at the Hospital Infantil de México Federico Gómez, where I completed my residency in Pediatrics and fellowship in Pediatric Neurology.
bio2: I care for babies, girls, boys, and adolescents with neurological conditions and neurodevelopmental disorders, always with a comprehensive, family-centered approach.
bio3: With a desire to make pediatric neurology more accessible and understandable, I developed the Ruta Neuropato — a tool that complements my practice and helps families understand, support, and nurture their children's development.
bio4: I firmly believe that every child has a unique story, strengths to discover, and an enormous potential to grow. My commitment is to accompany them with science, empathy, and closeness, because every brain has its own path and we can always find a solution.
